company.title: Company & settings
company.subtitle: Company details, code formats and smart placement rules
company.default_language_hint: Used by users who did not choose their own language.
company.codes_hint: This is how lot, unit and order codes are generated. Existing codes do not change.
company.tokens: Variables: {yy} 2-digit year, {yyyy} year, {mm} month, {nn} monthly counter (more “n” = more zeros: {nnnn}), {lot} lot code, {tech} technician number, {seq} the technician's own record number.
company.reservation_days_hint: Reservations on an open order are released automatically when they expire. Empty = never expire.
company.placement_hint: Points each criterion adds when choosing a slot for a unit. Higher = more important. Units of different types are never mixed in a slot.

w_hint.sameModel: The slot already holds the same model
w_hint.sameBrand: The slot already holds the same brand
w_hint.sameType: The slot already holds the same equipment type
w_hint.sameGrade: Extra if the grade also matches
w_hint.preferredArea: Extra if the area is marked for that type
w_hint.emptySlot: Base score of an empty slot
w_hint.fillStarted: Prefers slots that are already started

company.auto_place_hint: When a unit finishes testing, the system puts it in the slot that fits the rules of each rack level. If there is no room it stays unplaced and you are warned.
company.asset_format_hint: own tools and equipment; does not restart every month
company.inactivity_lock_hint: If no one uses the system for this long, the screen locks and the password must be entered again to continue (nothing you were doing is lost).

platform.title: Platform: companies
platform.subtitle: Create and manage the companies that use the system. Each has its own data, catalogs, users and permissions.
platform.slug_hint: Optional; lowercase letters, numbers and dashes. Generated from the name.
platform.joined: You are now an administrator of that company
platform.override_hint: This assigns the plan directly, without going through Stripe (nothing is charged). Use it for courtesy access, extended trials, or payments received outside the system.
platform.period_end_hint: Empty = no expiration (until you change it again).
platform.edit_plans_subtitle: What each company sees when subscribing. Price changes don't affect anyone already subscribed until their next renewal.
platform.price_annual_hint: The total yearly charge (not the per-month equivalent).
platform.price_empty_hint: Empty = this plan can't be purchased online (e.g. the free one).
platform.stripe_price_hint: Filled in automatically by "npm run stripe:setup". No need to edit by hand.

profile.title: My profile
profile.language_hint: Your language is remembered on all your devices.

billing.title: Subscription and billing
billing.subtitle: Current plan, usage and options to pay online
billing.trial_days_left_one: {{count}} day left in your free trial.
billing.trial_days_left_other: {{count}} days left in your free trial.
billing.past_due_hint: The last charge couldn't be processed. Update your payment method to avoid the system locking.
billing.stripe_not_configured: Online payments aren't set up on this system yet. The platform administrator can assign your plan manually in the meantime.
billing.not_purchasable_hint: This plan doesn't have a Stripe price set up yet.
billing.checkout_success: All set! Your plan is now active.
billing.blocked_trial: {{company}}'s free trial has expired. Pick a plan to keep using the system.
billing.blocked_canceled: {{company}}'s subscription was canceled. Pick a plan to reactivate the system.
billing.blocked_contact_admin: Ask your company's administrator to activate a plan so you can keep working.
